# `@grow-codes/zipkin` — agent quickstart (TypeScript)

Ships inside the npm package (`node_modules/@grow-codes/zipkin/AGENTS.md`). Use it instead of reading
the package source. Full docs: https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/zipkin/ · Service:
Zipkin · Categories: tracing.

```sh
npm i @grow-codes/zipkin        # Node >= 22.12; ESM and CommonJS
```

## Client

```ts
import { ZipkinClient, ZipkinConfig, isGrowError } from "@grow-codes/zipkin";
const client = ZipkinClient.fromEnv();        // GROW_ZIPKIN_* > vendor env > defaults
await client.health();                             // never throws for a down service
await client.close();                              // idempotent; flushes batches
```

Config precedence: explicit option > `GROW_ZIPKIN_<NAME>` > vendor variables > default. Common names:
`URL`, `TOKEN`, `CONNECT_TIMEOUT`, `REQUEST_TIMEOUT`, `TOTAL_TIMEOUT`, `MAX_RETRIES`, `CA_CERT`, `PROXY`.
Errors: `ZipkinError` with `code` (`CONFIG`, `AUTHENTICATION`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `NOT_FOUND`, `CONFLICT`,
`RATE_LIMITED`, `VALIDATION`, `UNAVAILABLE`, `TIMEOUT`, `UNSUPPORTED`, `CANCELLED`), `retryable`, `httpStatus`.
Branch on `code`, never on the message. Credentials are `Secret`; never log `reveal()` results.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/zipkin/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).

## Testing

`@grow-codes/zipkin/testing`: in-memory fakes (`InMemorySecretsProvider`, `MemoryLogExporter`, …).
